snippet.title: Shin Super Robot Wars - Walkthrough - Scenario 1 [Mysterious Invaders]
snippet.description:
Welcome to the classic but gold playthrough of Shin SRW! What can I say, this game can be very tedious but it is worth playing personally since this is my first SRW. Without this game, SRW is nothing to me. Anyways enjoy!

Starting off with the Voltes V sequence. 

STAGE 1 - 05:41
